title: The Mrichchhakatika of Sudraka

sensory: a poor Brahmin and a courtesan
vibeProfile.oneLine: The Little Clay Cart, a warm classic of ancient Sanskrit drama.

summary: The Mrichchhakatika, or The Little Clay Cart, is one of the best-loved of all ancient Sanskrit plays, a warm, humane drama of love between a poor but noble Brahmin and a wealthy, generous courtesan, entangled with political intrigue and a stolen cart of jewels. Unusually earthy and full of ordinary life, thieves, gamblers and townsfolk, it stands apart from the more courtly Sanskrit dramas. This classic edition with notes makes a delightful and human masterpiece accessible.
whyReadIt: The warmest, most human of Sanskrit plays, a love story of a poor Brahmin and a generous courtesan. A delightful classic.

funFacts.text: Its earthy realism and lowlife characters make it unlike almost any other surviving Sanskrit play.
